name: Data360 Beast Phase Proof Matrix
description: Machine-readable routing table for Salesforce Data 360 agent work. Use it after Beast preflight and before specialist skill routing.

preflight.fallbackRule: If a field is unknown and the task can proceed, state the assumption and lower confidence to documented, inferred, docs-unverified, or live-validation-unavailable.

limitSourcePolicy.default: Use current Data 360 Limits and Guidelines before legacy Customer Data Platform limits.
limitSourcePolicy.followThrough: When the current Data 360 limits page points to Data Services Billable Usage Types for Data 360, follow that source and treat the value as entitlement, usage, billing, or contract sensitive until proven in the target org.
limitSourcePolicy.legacyCdpUse: Use Customer Data Platform limits only when the user explicitly mentions CDP or Customer Data Platform, the target org is known to operate under that legacy license, or the answer is a labeled comparison.
limitSourcePolicy.unknownLicense: If license posture is unknown, answer from current Data 360 docs and call out that legacy CDP orgs can differ.

confidenceLabels.documented: Supported by current official Salesforce docs or OpenAPI, without target-org proof.
confidenceLabels.tested: Validated in an explicitly authorized live org with readback evidence.
confidenceLabels.inferred: Reasonable design or troubleshooting hypothesis that still needs target-org proof.

phases.owns: Connectors, connections, connector schema, refresh, ingestion setup, and connector permissions.
requiredSources: Official connector/setup docs when behavior or permissions matter
Current Data 360 Limits and Guidelines, not legacy CDP limits by default, when connector or connected CRM-org limits matter
OpenAPI for connector, connection, or stream payload mechanics
Target-org connection metadata for live proof
proofTargets: ingestion row or run status when available
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not assume the connector creates only the assets named in the UI.
Do not apply legacy Customer Data Platform CRM-org limits unless CDP is explicitly in scope or used as labeled comparison.
Do not assume global CLI org or default data space.
Do not expose connector secrets or copied source credentials.

phases.owns: Data streams, DLOs, transforms, ingestion status, formulas, and document processing prep.
requiredSources: Official docs for stream, transform, and formula behavior
Current Data 360 Limits and Guidelines plus Data Services Billable Usage Types when current docs route ingestion limits there
OpenAPI for stream, DLO, or transform payloads
Target-org DLO schema and transform output
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not use Query SQL as data stream formula syntax.
Do not edit stream-managed DLO fields directly.
Do not mask keys or event-time fields without downstream validation.

phases.owns: DMOs, mappings, relationships, identity resolution, Data Graphs, model-gallery anchor selection, grain, and relationship paths.
requiredSources: Model-gallery map for early DMO anchor and grain choice
Official mapping and relationship docs for behavior
Target data-space metadata for exact object and field names
proofTargets: identity resolution run status or counts
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not flatten standard model hubs into one generic customer object.
Do not model consent as a single Individual boolean.
Do not treat model-gallery names as runtime field names.

phases.owns: Data spaces, tags, classifications, security policies, masking, RBAC, ABAC, and access validation.
requiredSources: Official governance docs for access behavior and limits
Target-org permission, tag, classification, and policy metadata
Runtime proof from the intended user persona
proofTargets: permission set or permission set group readback
non-admin query or UI access test
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not treat data space assignment as data access.
Do not use System Admin visibility as governed runtime proof.
Do not claim policy behavior before propagation and user-persona testing.

phases.owns: Query SQL, Query v2, Profile API, metadata discovery, and query MCP usage.
requiredSources: Official query/profile docs when syntax or behavior matters
OpenAPI for query/profile endpoints
Target-org metadata for exact names and data space
proofTargets: governed user query proof when access matters
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not rely on global CLI state.
Do not assume query success proves segment, activation, transform, or analytics behavior.
Do not surface raw personal identifiers unless the use case and access allow it.

phases.owns: Calculated insights, streaming insights, CI SQL, measures, dimensions, validation, and materialized output.
requiredSources: Official CI or streaming insight docs for supported syntax and lifecycle
Static SQL rules from the specialist skill
Target-org CI output DMO metadata
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not use a CI for simple row normalization that belongs in prepare.
Do not use streaming insights in segments or activations unless current docs support the exact path.
Do not treat SQL preview as materialization proof.

phases.owns: C360 semantic models, logical views, metrics, dimensions, shared dimensions, and governed business definitions.
requiredSources: Official semantic layer docs for supported metadata and behavior
Target model metadata for fields, dimensions, measures, and relationships
Business definition source for metrics
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not expose multiple conflicting definitions of the same metric.
Do not remove required primary keys or CI fields from semantic models.
Do not claim analytics parity without report or dashboard proof.

phases.owns: Agentforce Data Libraries, manual search indexes, chunking, hybrid/vector search, retrievers, citations, and RAG grounding.
requiredSources: RAG/search-index playbook for architecture and debug flow
Official docs for ADL, search indexes, retrievers, and citations
Target-org index DMO, chunk DMO, source DMO, and retriever metadata
proofTargets: chunk and index DMO row counts
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not treat CSV, JSON, or XML as unstructured only because it is file-based.
Do not use hybrid search as a category lookup engine.
Do not upgrade the LLM before proving retrieval context relevance.

phases.owns: Segments, DBT segments, member counts, publish readiness, and membership proof.
requiredSources: OpenAPI for segment payload shape
Official segment docs for behavior and limits
Target-org DMO metadata, relationship metadata, and segment status
proofTargets: member retrieval only when the delta window supports it
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not assume query-safe SQL is segment-safe SQL.
Do not assume a create response means the segment is healthy.
Do not use graph-only enrichment as activation criteria unless it is segment-safe.

phases.owns: Activation targets, activations, data action targets, data action delivery, publish status, and destination proof.
requiredSources: Official activation or destination docs for setup and behavior
OpenAPI for target or activation payload shape
Target-org target, activation, audience, and governed access metadata
proofTargets: delivery proof from the destination when available
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not assume a visible segment can be activated.
Do not publish to an external destination without explicit authorization.
Do not expose raw identifiers or contact fields unless the use case and policy allow it.

phases.owns: Data actions, triggered flows, DataObjectDataChgEvent, activation-triggered flows, refresh cadence, and monitoring.
requiredSources: Official data action, event, and Flow docs for behavior
OpenAPI for data action target and data action payload shape
Target-org event, flow, and monitoring metadata
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not put raw profile IDs, email addresses, phone numbers, or addresses into external payloads unless approved.
Do not treat event configuration as delivery proof.
Do not ignore refresh cadence or late-arriving data.

phases.owns: API surface selection, External Client App auth, development environments, data kits, packageability, deployment path, metadata coverage, and cost/usage.
requiredSources: Official Developer Guide docs for auth, APIs, metadata, and packageability
OpenAPI for runtime API mechanics
Target-org data kit and metadata coverage proof
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not treat standard Platform metadata deployment as sufficient for every Data 360 asset.
Do not package raw data.
Do not reuse Connect REST auth assumptions for Data 360 Direct API token exchange.
